setup: Use a change previously audited as coherent (all known findings fixed), with its artifacts unmodified.
expected_behavior: Gives an explicit verdict of 'Ready to implement' or 'Ready with minors' - never silence in place of a verdict
Invents no findings: anything reported must cite a source or quote both sides of a real disagreement
Closes with one line per check (1-3) stating what was examined and that it came back clean
Lists the best-practice sources used per domain, drawn from the local-source sweep and the endorsed source registry
